name: Sending status "pending" returns 422 with VALIDATION_ERROR

steps.name: And there is an open job with title "Backend Engineer" in "Remote" at company "Acme Corp"

When I send PATCH /applications/{application_for_candidate_4}/status with body

fullName: Application Management: Sending status "pending" returns 422 with VALIDATION_ERROR
